days_until_due.description: due_date minus the assessment date, in days. Negative once overdue - the alert cites how overdue, not just that it is (SD027 1's proof line).

due_date.description: The obligation's expiry/next_due date the countdown is measured against, as an ISO 8601 date.

obligation_ref.description: A human-readable label for the specific obligation (holder + credential type, or insured party + policy number) - what the alert names.

obligation_type.description: What kind of compliance obligation this is, e.g. certification, insurance. One value per wired feeder register.

source_fact_id.description: The specific feeder Fact row this verdict tracks - the citation's derived_from anchor.

source_shelf_type.description: Which feeder register this verdict was derived from (certification_register, insurance_certificate, ...) - lets the alert cite its source (SD027 1's proof line: every number proves itself).

verdict.description: The countdown state: COMPLIANT (>90 days out), EXPIRING_90, EXPIRING_30, EXPIRING_7, or EXPIRED (days_until_due < 0 - stays EXPIRED, never silently reverts, until the source record itself renews/retires).
